limitations: One font blob per AddFont call: the pinned add_fonts takes a Vec of sources and registers them as one batch, so N calls produce N generation bumps. FontIds, family names and resolution are unaffected (documented on the public method and in TEXT_ABI.md); a batched variadic API is a straightforward later extension if a consumer needs it.

family_found reports family PRESENCE in the catalog (all_font_names), not which face Fontique matched: the pinned public API exposes no matched-family report, so presence is the honest observable (a present family always answers a resolve from that family; Fontique tries families in priority order).

The family-presence cache is keyed by catalog generation and rebuilt lazily on the first resolve after a registration (all_font_names enumerates and sorts the whole catalog); with no registrations the cache is built once per process.

Registration is process-stable with no unregister, mirroring the pin; the font-record v2 change replaces the v1 reserved word, so v1-era Go mirrors against a v2 artifact fail the service-version validation loudly (the loader pins exact hashes, so mixed-version pairs cannot load).
